tools.name: describe_engine
tools.description: Free. Describe Delta Signal: layers, stings, defaults, limits and prices.

tools.name: preview_card
tools.description: Free. Render the SSTV signature card image for a message (PNG) so you can see what the picture sting will carry.

tools.name: render_signature
tools.description: Render a Delta Signal audio signature (WAV, 48 kHz) that hides your message: in the heartbeat rhythm, as text in the spectrogram, as an inaudible watermark, and optionally as an SSTV picture, a ggwave data chirp or modem tones. Returns a download link (kept 7 days) and a manifest. Survives YouTube-g

tools.name: decode_audio
tools.description: Decode every Delta Signal layer from a WAV or MP3 file at an https URL: heartbeat cipher, spectral glyph, prime count, watermark (needs the seed used to render), ggwave, modem text and SSTV pictures (returned as PNG).

tools.name: verify_signature
tools.description: Verify a Delta Signal audio signature at an https WAV URL: returns which hidden layers are present (found_layers) and whether the audio matches an expected message (matches: true/false, or null if no expected_message given). Cheaper than full decode — use it when you only need to confirm presence or
